title: STARTEX card
description: Facilitator control card read aloud to open the exercise: sets the clock, conditions and the baseline status of key systems.

exerciseTime.description: Exercise clock when the card is read, H:MM (normally 0:00)

day.description: In-scenario day or date shown next to the time

location.description: Where the scenario takes place (facility name)

load.description: Passenger or operational load at start, one short line

staffing.description: Staffing level at start, one short line
examples: Full shifts in Operations, Maintenance and IT

narration.description: Opening statement the facilitator reads aloud to start play (2-4 sentences)
examples: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:00 AM on a busy Thursday at North Coast International Airport.

status.description: Baseline status board at STARTEX: one row per system or area (3-7 rows)
green = normal, yellow = degraded, red = down

facilitatorNote.description: Private note for the facilitator (not read aloud)
examples: Confirm every table has the player briefing packet and a blank ICS 201 before reading.
